summary: [spec fidelity, ATIP feedback] `env` appears on only two options (`--actor` of `feature new` and `scenario new`, the only clap `env =`). Code also reads CANON_ROLE when `--as` is absent (every command but `schema`, which the contract says an environment variable MUST NOT filter) and CANON_SKILLS_SOURCE when `--skills-source` is absent (named in defaultNote and in help only). Spec 10.7.1 defines `env` as the variable the parser reads when the option is absent; the brief limits it to --actor ("for now"), so this is a documented gap, not a defect. Question for the ATIP author: should `--as` carry `env: CANON_ROLE` on the commands where it is read, given 10.2.2 forbids the environment to filter `schema`? Blast radius: an agent reading `schema` cannot learn that CANON_ROLE sets `--as`; the guides say it.
